candidates.title: As the Deer

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: As the deer panteth for the water
So my soul longeth after thee
You alone are my hearts desire
And I long to worship thee

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: You alone are my strength my shield
To You alone may my spirit yield
You alone are my hearts desire
And I long to worship thee

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Youre my friend and You are my brother
Even though You are a king
I love You more than any other
So much more than anything

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: You alone are my my strength my shield
To You alone may my spirit yield
You alone are my hearts desire
And I long to worship thee

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: I want You more than gold or silver
Only You can satisfy
You alone are the real joy giver and the apple of my eye
You alone are my strength my shield
To You alone make my spirit yield
You alone are my hearts desire
And I long to worship thee

candidates.notes: Spelling corrected (dear→deer, herarts→hearts). Capitalized You as reference to God. Formatted for screen.
